description: Build the multi-step portfolio editor with 10 steps, three portfolio templates, and all supporting UI components. This is the largest feature. Includes: (1) base UI component library (Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Card, Modal), (2) form components integrating React Hook Form + Zod, (3) Wizard and WizardStep components for navigation, (4) 10 step components covering all portfolio sections (personal, education, skills, projects, certifications, experience, achievements, social, resume, design), (5) three responsive portfolio templates (Minimal Professional, Modern Developer, Creative), (6) PortfolioRenderer component for template selection. Depends on FEAT-002 (types) and FEAT-003 (utilities).
steps: Create src/components/ui/Button.tsx: FC component with props { variant: primary|secondary|danger, size: sm|md|lg, disabled, onClick, children, className, type }. Style variants using Tailwind with dark theme colors from design spec (#4FD1C5 primary, #22333B surface, etc.).
Create src/components/ui/Input.tsx: FC component { type, placeholder, value, onChange, onBlur, error, disabled, className }. Show error message below input if error prop provided.
Create src/components/ui/Textarea.tsx: FC component { rows, placeholder, value, onChange, onBlur, error, disabled }. Similar to Input.
Create src/components/ui/Select.tsx: FC component { options: { label, value }[], value, onChange, error, disabled, placeholder }. Render <select> element with option group support if needed.
Create src/components/ui/Card.tsx: FC component { children, className, hover } wrapping content in Tailwind card styles (rounded border, surface background).
Create src/components/ui/Modal.tsx: FC component { isOpen, onClose, title, children, actions: { label, onClick }[] }. Simple modal overlay with title and action buttons.

Create src/components/form/FormField.tsx: FC component wrapping a form field with label, input/textarea/select (children), error display, and required asterisk. Integrates with React Hook Form's controller pattern.
Create src/components/form/FormError.tsx: FC component displaying error message in red text below field.

Create src/components/wizard/Wizard.tsx: FC component managing multi-step form. Props: { children: ReactNode[], currentStep: number, onNext, onPrev, isStepComplete: (step) => boolean, totalSteps }. Renders step header with progress bar, current step, navigation buttons (Previous always enabled, Next enabled if isStepComplete), step count.
Create src/components/wizard/WizardStep.tsx: FC component { number, title, children }. Renders step content within Wizard context.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepPersonalInfo.tsx: Form for Step 1 with fields: full_name, headline, bio, professional_email, personal_website, city, state, country. Uses useFormWithAutosave for auto-save on blur. Show 'Saved' toast on success, error toast on failure.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepEducation.tsx: Form for Step 2. List existing education entries with edit/delete buttons. 'Add Education' button shows form. Form fields: institution, degree, department, specialization, start_year, end_year, cgpa, description. Save Entry button saves single entry. Validation: years are numbers 1900-2100, end >= start.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepSkills.tsx: Form for Step 3. Display skills grouped by category. 'Add Skill' button shows form (skill_name, category dropdown). Save Skill button adds to list. Disable add button if 50 skills reached. Show skill count.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepProjects.tsx: Form for Step 4. Display project list. 'Add Project' button shows form. Form fields: title, description, tech_stack, category, image upload with preview, github_url, live_url, start_date, end_date, featured checkbox. Save Project button. Featured projects highlighted in list.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepCertifications.tsx: Form for Step 5. Similar multi-entry pattern. Fields: title, issuer, issue_date (required), expiration_date (optional), credential_id, credential_verification_url, document upload. Validate dates.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepExperience.tsx: Form for Step 6. Fields: job_title, company_name, employment_type (dropdown), location, start_date, end_date, is_current (checkbox), description. If is_current=true, hide end_date input. Save Entry button.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepAchievements.tsx: Form for Step 7. Fields: title, description, achievement_date (required), category (dropdown: award/publication/speaking/community/other). Save Entry button.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepSocialLinks.tsx: Form for Step 8. Platform dropdown (github, linkedin, behance, twitter, dribbble, instagram, website, other). URL input with http(s):// validation. Enforce unique platform per profile. Save Link button.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepResume.tsx: Form for Step 9. Resume PDF upload field. Resume privacy toggle (private|public with explanation). Show current resume link if uploaded. Save Resume button.

Create src/components/wizard/steps/StepDesignSettings.tsx: Form for Step 10. Template selection radio buttons (3 options). Accent color picker (palette + hex input). Live preview of PortfolioRenderer component on right side. Save Design button.

Create src/components/portfolio/MinimalTemplate.tsx: Renders profile using Minimal Professional template - text-heavy, clean layout, vertical sections, neutral colors with accent highlights. Sections: hero (name, headline, photo), about, skills, projects, experience, certifications, achievements, social links.

Create src/components/portfolio/ModernTemplate.tsx: Renders profile using Modern Developer template - card-based layout, grid projects, sidebar skills, dark theme. Hero with gradient, main content area with sections, right sidebar with skills grouped by category.

Create src/components/portfolio/CreativeTemplate.tsx: Renders profile using Creative Portfolio template - image-first layout, masonry grid for projects, bento-grid arrangement, bold typography. Hero with large background image or gradient, projects in masonry grid with hover effects.

Create src/components/portfolio/PortfolioRenderer.tsx: FC component { profile } that selects correct template based on profile.template_name, applies profile.accent_color via CSS variable --accent-color, applies profile.theme_preference (dark|light) via CSS class. Renders selected template.
Create integration test file: tests/integration/portfolio-editor.test.tsx showing multi-step flow: navigate steps, save entries, complete form, verify completion tracking.
acceptance_criteria: All UI components render without errors; Button shows all 3 variants
Form components accept value, onChange, error props and display error messages
Wizard navigates between steps; Previous button always enabled, Next enabled only if current step passes validation
Step 1 (PersonalInfo) saves on blur; verify 'Saved' toast appears
Step 2 (Education) supports add/edit/delete; Save Entry creates entry; date validation prevents end < start
Step 3 (Skills) shows skills grouped by category; max 50 limit prevents adding beyond limit
Step 4 (Projects) shows project image preview; featured projects highlighted
Step 8 (SocialLinks) prevents duplicate platforms for same profile (UI validation; DB enforces)
Step 9 (Resume) supports PDF upload and privacy toggle
Step 10 (DesignSettings) live preview updates when template or color changed
MinimalTemplate renders all portfolio sections vertically; content adapts to screen size
ModernTemplate renders projects in grid; sidebar shows skills by category
CreativeTemplate renders projects in masonry layout with responsive sizing
PortfolioRenderer selects correct template and applies accent color + theme CSS variables
All components pass TypeScript strict mode without any implicit any
Multi-step integration test passes: navigate 10 steps, save entries, completion % increases
verification: Run `npm run dev` → navigate to /editor → expect Wizard with 10 steps loads, Step 1 displays with form fields
Step 1: Fill 'Full name', blur field → expect 'Saved' toast appears within 2s
Step 2: Click 'Add Education', fill institution + degree, click 'Save Entry' → expect entry appears in list
Step 3: Click 'Add Skill' 50 times, attempt 51st → expect add button disabled
Step 4: Upload project image → expect preview displays; mark featured → expect highlight in list
Step 5-9: Repeat add/save/delete pattern for each entry type
Step 10: Select 'Modern Developer' template + accent color #3B82F6 → expect live preview updates showing template and blue accents
Click Next at each step → expect Previous button enabled, Next button disabled until form valid and saved
Navigate to /p/[slug] with published profile → expect correct template renders with profile data
Run `npm run test -- portfolio-editor` → expect integration test passes
Run `npm run build` → expect no errors, all components bundled
findings: All 25 steps implemented, multi-step editor fully functional. Created 6 UI base components (Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Card, Modal) with Tailwind dark theme styling. Created 2 form wrapper components (FormField, FormError) for React Hook Form integration. Created Wizard and WizardStep components for multi-step navigation with progress tracking. Implemented 10 portfolio editor steps covering all profile sections: Personal Info (auto-save on blur), Education/Skills/Projects/Certifications/Experience/Achievements (add/save/delete pattern), Social Links (unique platform enforcement), Resume (privacy toggle), and Design Settings (template selection + live preview). Created 3 responsive portfolio templates: Minimal Professional (vertical text-heavy), Modern Developer (card-based with sidebar), Creative Portfolio (masonry grid with timeline). PortfolioRenderer component handles template selection and accent color theming. All components pass TypeScript strict mode. Integration test suite passes with 13 passing tests covering wizard navigation, button states, and step completion tracking.
